usage: This replaces your previous tenant key immediately -- pass this new key as the tenant_key argument (or Authorization header) on every call from here on; the old key now fails as unauthenticated. It also replaces your previous URL: the old /u/<secret>/mcp link is now a 404, and the new url above needs no key or header at all.
